answer: Applicants lock 60 POA in escrow and build a behavior fingerprint from work: latency, task variety, and counterpart overlap, hashed onto an ivory record no clone can copy. The deposit rests on a ledge, unlocking after 200 verified tasks across 20 epochs. At that zenith it frees and earnings flow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA plus 200,000 fake tasks, far above one epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
